newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Commerzbank Hungary unit boosts '96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank Hungary unit boosts '96 profit.

text.p: The Hungarian subsidiary of Commerzbank AG boosted its balance sheet total by 31 percent and its pre-tax profit by 27 percent in 1996, the bank said in a statement on Thursday.
"Being aware of the result figures we can evaluate 1996 as a successful year," Commerzbank (Budapest) Rt chairman Hans H. von Rosenberg Lipinsky said in the statement.

Commerzbank Rt's balance sheet total rose to 75.77 billion forints last year from 57.99 billion in 1995, while the bank increased its pre-tax profit to 1.29 billion forints from 818 million in 1995, the statement said. @
The bank's after-tax profit grew to 1.06 billion forints in 1996 from 672 million in 1995, the statement said.
The figures are unaudited, non-consolidated and were calcaluted according to the Hungarian Accounting Standard.
Average consumer price inflation was 23.6 percent in Hungary in 1996.
